name: AI Research Lab
description: ML / AI research group workspace: paper club, experiments, evals, infra, code-review, plus a private leads channel and Researchers / Lab Leads usergroups.

channels.name: paper-club
channels.purpose: Share papers, schedule readings, post discussion threads.

channels.name: experiments
channels.purpose: Run logs, hypothesis posts, result threads. Tag with model + dataset.

channels.name: model-eval
channels.purpose: Evaluation runs, leaderboard updates, regression triage.

channels.name: infra
channels.purpose: Cluster issues, dataset versioning, pipeline ownership.

channels.name: code-review
channels.purpose: Cross-team review of model code, data tooling, eval harnesses.
